title: Seitan Wraps with Ukrainian Twist
description: A fusion dish bringing together the heartiness of Ukrainian cuisine and the simplicity of Chinese street food. Served in a crispy wrap with marinated seitan.
instructions: 1. Cut the seitan into thin strips and marinate in a mixture of 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp garlic, and 1 tbsp sesame oil for at least 30 minutes.
2. Grill the seitan until golden brown and crispy.
3. Warm the wraps in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
4. Fill each wrap with a portion of the seitan, Ukrainian sauerkraut, chopped green onions, and chopped cilantro.
5. Drizzle with a bit of soy sauce and serve immediately.
